FIX THE THREE OPEN REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #801 (docs(finder): F4 archetype ranking UI design). Update only the existing branch codex/run-38015883683-1; its head must be 3976abff83df228065d550babe9275a32f6741b8 -- if it is not, stop and report the SHA you found.

THE FINDINGS, AS THE REVIEWER WROTE THEM (line numbers are at 3976abf):

[F1] docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md:2023 -- **Register the new empty flow on the local-search route** Fresh evidence after the accepted support-matrix disposition is that `rankingsEmptyResults` explicitly switches back to Any and issues `POST /api/local/search` (lines 1518–1522), but this task only adds the rankings route and extends the control-route coverage. The existing local-search matrix row has a closed four-scenario `scenario_coverage`, so following these instructions leaves `rankings_empty_results` absent even though that flow exercises the route, allowing `support_route_matrix_complete` to report an incomplete route/scenario contract. Extend the local-search row and its focused assertion with this new scenario.

[F2] docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md:643 -- **Assign the Any-count sentinel before testing exact totals** The current response exposes only `total` and `total_is_capped`, and—as this paragraph notes—the existing API sets the flag identically for exactly 10,000 and for overflow. Although the design requires three distinct component states, the later exact PR inventories never assign the proposed 10,001-row local-search sentinel to F2d PR1, slice 1c, F4a, or F4b; PR1's enumerated work is limited to the selected-ranking route. An implementation following the plan therefore cannot distinguish the exact and overflow states or satisfy the stated test. Make the sentinel and its response semantics a mandatory owned API prerequisite (including generated-client updates), or retain only the conservative ambiguous state and test.

[F3] docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md:2032 -- **Create the missing Inspect page test explicitly** This exact F4b inventory says to modify the Inspect page's test, but a repository-wide file search under `apps/web/src/routes/inspect` finds only `+page.svelte` and `+page.ts`; no page test currently exists. Following the list therefore either omits the return-link regression or tries to modify a nonexistent file. Name `apps/web/src/routes/inspect/+page.test.ts` as a created file (and any required test host) so the enabled/disabled return-link and state-carrying round-trip behavior has an owned test.

FOR EACH FINDING: first verify it against the files at the head commit and decide whether it is correct. Fix every correct finding in the files this PR already changes; for a finding you judge incorrect, change nothing for it. Do not widen scope beyond these findings. Keep every existing negative assertion in any test. Run every test that reads a file you change (and bash -n / ruff check where relevant) and make sure they pass. Do not contact production.
